howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你实现网页和 iOS 上的 Apple Pay 支付，包括商户验证、令牌处理和安全结账。
howto.when: 当你需要为结账、订阅或钱包优先转化改进集成 Apple Pay 时触发。

say.text: 帮我将 Apple Pay 集成到网页结账流程中。
say.note: Claude 会规划并指导实施步骤。

say.text: 验证我的 Apple Pay 商户 ID 是否有效。
say.note: Claude 会检查前置条件并给出清单。

say.text: 测试 Apple Pay 在沙盒环境中的支付流程。
say.note: Claude 会执行验证并记录结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you implement Apple Pay on web and iOS, including merchant validation, token handling, and production-safe checkout flows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Apple Pay for checkout, subscriptions, or wallet-first conversion improvements.

say_en.text: Integrate Apple Pay into my web checkout flow.
say_en.note: Claude will plan and guide implementation steps.

say_en.text: Verify my Apple Pay merchant ID is valid.
say_en.note: Claude will check prerequisites and provide a checklist.

say_en.text: Test Apple Pay payment flow in sandbox environment.
say_en.note: Claude will execute validation and record results.
